title: Reconfirm setup before preparation
description: Gate final print preparation on a fresh explicit reconfirmation of the exact selected loading-procedure and print-configuration revisions.
acceptanceCriteria: Preparation remains unavailable until the current loading and configuration revisions are explicitly reconfirmed
Reconfirmation records exact revision identities, disclosure version, action, and timestamp
Changing either selected revision invalidates the pending reconfirmation
A prior preparation's reconfirmation cannot satisfy a new preparation attempt

steps.details: Add a per-attempt reconfirmation value tied to exact loading/configuration revisions and a unique preparation-attempt identity.
Block final preparation when reconfirmation is absent or stale and return structured reasons naming each required action.
Show exact assumptions and unobservable conditions in a keyboard-operable confirmation that defaults to unconfirmed.
Verify initial block, successful confirmation, revision-change invalidation, cancellation, and inability to reuse an earlier attempt's confirmation.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; add a per-attempt gate to the existing preparation workflow only.
Reconfirmation does not communicate with or control a printer.
Keep the record immutable when consumed by a preparation.
